race.title: Paxtons Pity Me Workshop Top Peformance Novices' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: SOLDIER IN MAYO has run well on 2 of 3 starts over fences and appeals as the most likely winner in a thin race. Brave Move and Alidam are potential dangers, the latter worth noting in the betting for new connections. SOLDIER IN MAYO (IRE) BRAVE MOVE (IRE) ALIDAM (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Soldier In Mayo (10/11), Brave Move (10/3), Knacker Trapper (7/2), Mr Globalist (12/1), Alidam (20/1)
